This week’s highlights: Billy Miller joins Schwab Network; Carlos Domingo joins NYSE Live; Securitize expands revenue potential; blockchain transforms finance; and tokenization unlocks collateral capital. Schwab Network Tokenizing Equities: SECZ COO on Adding Stocks to Blockchain, ARK Partnership Billy Miller explains how compliant, asset-backed tokenization can connect established securities with investors who prefer to transact onchain. WATCH NOW New York Stock Exchange Securitize CEO Carlos Domingo on Tokenized Stocks and the Future of Capital Markets In this NYSE Live interview, Carlos Domingo, CEO of Securitize, discusses the company's recent launch of Securitize Stocks, the growth of tokenized assets, and the broader evolution of blockchain-based financial infrastructure. WATCH NOW The Block StoneX Raises Securitize Price Target 50% as Tokenized Stock Platform Opens New Revenue Stream StoneX believes Securitize Stocks marks the company’s evolution from a tokenization vendor into a market operator with new transaction and servicing revenue. READ MORE Barron’s The Biggest Change to Stock Trading in Decades is Coming to Wall Street Blockchain-powered tokenization could transform Wall Street as profoundly as the shift from paper to electronic trading. READ MORE CNBC Tokenization Could Unleash Tens of Billions of Dollars in Trapped Capital, Nasdaq CEO Says Digitizing securities alongside money flows could make collateral more fluid across the global financial system, according to Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman.
